column2: #Step 1: Create helper functions for loading data from Github
#Create function to load data into a data frame from Github URL.

#Function load_data takes in the Github url as input, temporary saves the .xlsx file and returns the data as a data frame. R needs a local path to read .xlsx files. The following function streamlines the process.
#We temporarily create a file path on our system, we specify that it will store a .xlsx file
#Then we download the file from our Github URL and store it to our temp path. We specify "wb" for write and binary mode, best for Windows systems
#Finally we return the data frame that can now be read by read_excel.
